answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 49441 Country: CN Title: Jumma prayer in Non muslim country Question: I am studying in China and belong to Pakistan. I want to know about the FARZIAT of Jumuah prayer in a non-Muslim country. Should we offer as regularly (Fardh) as in our own country? Answer ID: 49441 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 44/44/M=01/1435) Ones of the conditions which make Jumuah valid is that the place is a city whether it is a Muslim country or a non-Muslim country. Hence if it is city where you live in China or situated around a city and there is a group of Muslims i.e. three namazis other than imam who perform jumuah, then jumuah shall be fardh there and it should be offered considering it fardh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
